_comment: TEMPLATE for <V6 data root>/config/us_stocks.json. Every value is null and NOT_APPROVED until the owner approves it. A value is used only when its approval is APPROVED; anything else is treated as missing and Module E answers EXECUTION_CONFIG_INCOMPLETE (no trade). Never copy values from V4.

data_provider.name: alpaca
data_provider.decision: owner 2026-11-24 (provisional): Alpaca IEX REAL-TIME 5-minute bars, V6 data-only credential; delayed SIP is never used or a fallback; real-time SIP is a future upgrade. IEX is a single venue, not the consolidated tape.

min_quantity.decision: IC-2 minimum quantity (recommended 0.01 = one step; Alpaca fractional orders start at $1 notional)

value.commission_source: Alpaca support, 'Commission & Clearing Fees' (https://alpaca.markets/support/commission-clearing-fees): no commission for self-directed accounts trading US-listed securities through the API

fee_schedule.decision: owner 2026-11-24: sell-side SEC Section 31 + FINRA TAF (with the per-trade cap), dated rates in v6_runtime/fees_us.py; commission $0 from Alpaca's published pricing (verified 2026-11-24). CAT pass-through fee NOT modelled (rate unverified).

bar_settle_seconds.decision: feed: seconds after a bar's end before it is treated as complete

eod_flatten_buffer_minutes.decision: ME-6 (owner: EOD flat mandatory): minutes before the ACTUAL session close (13:00 on early-close days) at which open positions are closed (recommended 5)

entry_cutoff_minutes.decision: ME-6: no entry candle opening at/after close minus this (recommended 15; must be >= the flatten buffer)

short_margin_rate.decision: ME-7: capital reserved per $ of short notional in the simulation (Reg T initial short requirement is 150% incl. proceeds = 0.5 own equity; NOT a real $1,000-account reproduction: FINRA requires $2,000 minimum equity for margin)

short_quantity_step.decision: ME-7: Alpaca does not support fractional short sales ('We do not support short sales in fractional orders'): 1 mirrors the provider; 0.01 is a simulation-only assumption

short_min_quantity.decision: ME-7: minimum short quantity (a multiple of short_quantity_step)

short_borrow_assumption.decision: simulated borrow: SPY/QQQ/AAPL/MSFT assumed easy-to-borrow and always available; no borrow fee (positions flattened before every close; Alpaca: no borrow fee for ETB shorts held overnight since 2025-10-01); locate/hard-to-borrow not simulated
